name: Slope
description: Mean terrain slope over the footprint

name: Slope variability
description: Standard deviation of slope over the footprint

name: Aspect (sine)
description: East-west orientation

name: Aspect (cosine)
description: North-south orientation

name: Canopy height (RH98)
description: GEDI 98th percentile relative height

name: Canopy cover
description: GEDI canopy cover fraction

name: Structural complexity (WSCI)
description: Waveform structural complexity index

name: Off-nadir angle
description: Mean off-nadir viewing angle of the images covering the footprint

name: Sun elevation
description: Mean sun elevation of the images covering the footprint

name: Azimuth concentration
description: Mean resultant length of the images' viewing azimuths (0 when evenly spread, 1 when all from one direction)

name: Viewing azimuth (sine)
description: East-west component of the mean viewing azimuth

name: Viewing azimuth (cosine)
description: North-south component of the mean viewing azimuth

name: Stereo ratio
description: Share of images acquired as in-track stereo

name: Forward-reverse balance
description: Share of forward-looking minus share of reverse-looking images

name: Leaf-on fraction
description: Share of images acquired between 9 March and 13 October (leaf-on season)

name: Absolute geoaccuracy
description: Mean absolute geolocation accuracy of the images covering the footprint

name: Relative geoaccuracy
description: Mean relative geolocation accuracy of the images covering the footprint

name: Site
description: The 18 sites (Table 1)

name: Level II ecoregion
description: Ecoregion of the footprint
source: CEC Level II (Commission for Environmental Cooperation, 1997)

name: Land-cover class
description: Class of the footprint, with the ten most common classes kept separate and all other classes combined into one group
